input.title: Does a ProcessorFilter "*" wildcard apply outside documentId?
input.description: Two processor notes carried a CONTRADICTS edge over whether ProcessorFilter's "*" is a general wildcard or documentId-only. Reactor 6.2.2-dev.47 source settles it: documentId-only.

input.resolution: Dissolved. @powerhousedao/reactor@6.2.2-dev.47 matchesFilter() tests for "*" only inside the documentId branch, so d7ef28bc describes the shipped behaviour exactly. 6a3275cd's 2026-08-13 correction already asserts the identical per-field rule, so the two notes no longer disagree - the CONTRADICTS edge points at a superseded revision rather than a live conflict. The codegen defect d7ef28bc cited is also gone: neither the analytics nor the relational template in @powerhousedao/codegen@6.2.2-dev.47 emits scope: ["*"], and both now carry a comment stating that only documentId honours the wildcard. A dated correction paragraph was appended to d7ef28bc so its now-stale claims about the sibling note and the template stop misleading readers; the CONTRADICTS edge is kept as provenance of the correction.
